catalogue_note:
Prefix groups are selectable project codes. The standards section is reference metadata only; standard numbers are not equipment prefixes. Normative class-code selections must be checked against the current edition of the applicable standard. Two-letter IEC 81346-2:2019 entries in this catalogue are selected examples, not a complete normative table. Practical project tags remain explicitly separated from IEC class codes. Norm selector profiles distinguish normative standards from local project-tag suggestions. A standard reference does not itself imply a prefix code. Application tags (CCTV, FIRE, MIVA, PLC, DURESS, etc.) are explicitly non-normative project conventions.

Protocol catalogue addition (2026-11-21): Protocol names such as KNX, BACnet, DALI, Modbus, MQTT and Zigbee are stored as project/system labels, not as IEC 81346-2 object-class prefixes. Normative references identify the relevant protocol standards; verify current national adoption and edition before contractual use.

standards.title: Circuit documentation, diagrams and designation of electrical equipment
standards.scope: Historical German standards series covering circuit documentation and identification/designation of electrical equipment. Parts have different successors.
standards.status: Withdrawn / superseded
successors: DIN EN 61082-1 (preparation of electrotechnical documents; successor for general document preparation)
DIN EN IEC 81346-1:2022 (structuring principles and reference designations)
DIN EN IEC 81346-2:2020 national adoption of IEC 81346-2:2019; international IEC 81346-2:2026 is the newer edition
standards.notes: DIN 40719-2:1978-06, designation of electrical equipment, is withdrawn. DIN Media lists DIN 6779, DIN EN 61346 and DIN EN 81346 as successor stages. Do not treat DIN 40719 as a current prefix-code table.

standards.title: Graphical symbols for diagrams
standards.scope: Historical German series of graphical symbols for electrical diagrams and installation plans; it concerns symbols, not reference designation prefix codes.
standards.status: Withdrawn / superseded
successors: DIN EN 60617 series; current international symbol database: IEC 60617
standards.notes: Examples: DIN 40900-3 was replaced by DIN EN 60617-3; DIN 40900-4 by DIN EN 60617-4; DIN 40900-11 by DIN EN 60617-11; DIN 40900-12 by DIN EN 60617-12. Individual part status and national adoption should be checked where relevant.

standards.title: Graphical symbols for diagrams
standards.scope: Earlier IEC publication series for electrotechnical diagram symbols.
standards.status: Legacy series; superseded and incorporated into IEC 60617
successors: IEC 60617 database - Graphical symbols for diagrams
standards.notes: IEC 60617-11:1996 explicitly superseded IEC 617-11:1983. IEC 60617 is the maintained IEC database for diagram symbols; it is not an equipment designation or prefix-code standard.

standards.title: Graphical symbols for diagrams
standards.scope: Current IEC database of standardized graphical symbols for electrotechnical diagrams.
standards.status: Published 2026-03-04
standards.notes: IEC identifies this database as the official source for diagram symbols. It is separate from the IEC 81346 reference designation and object-class coding system.

standards.title: Structuring principles and reference designations - Part 1: Basic rules
standards.scope: General rules for structuring systems and formulating unambiguous reference designations.
standards.status: Published; Edition 2 (2022)
standards.notes: Current general framework identified in the ISO/IEC catalogue. Use together with the relevant sector and object-class parts.

standards.title: Structuring principles and reference designations - Part 2: Classification of objects and codes for classes
standards.scope: Object-classification schemes and associated letter codes used in reference designations.
standards.status: Edition 3 in publication process; stage 60.00 on 2026-10-16; next publication stage scheduled 2026-11-27
standards.notes: The 2026 revision adds and modifies classes, changes class names and marks obsolete classes. The existing selectable IEC 81346-2:2019 list in this JSON is therefore explicitly marked legacy. Do not assume its codes/descriptions are a complete or current 2026 table; update the actual class entries only against an authorized copy of IEC 81346-2:2026.

standards.title: Structuring principles and reference designations - Part 12: Construction works and building services
standards.scope: Structuring and reference designation rules and object classes/letter codes for construction works and building services.
standards.status: Published; confirmed in 2024 and remains current
standards.notes: This part is sector-specific for construction works and building services. It is not interchangeable with IEC 81346-2.

standards.title: German adoption of IEC 81346-2:2019
standards.scope: National German adoption of the 2019 object-classification edition.
standards.status: Edition associated with IEC 81346-2:2019; check DIN catalogue for latest national adoption
successors: IEC 81346-2:2026 (international Edition 3; national adoption may follow separately)
standards.notes: Do not infer that the 2026 IEC edition is already adopted as a DIN or NBN national publication.

standards.title: Algemeen Reglement op de Elektrische Installaties, Books 1-3
standards.scope: Belgian statutory safety rules for low/very-low voltage, high-voltage, and transmission/distribution installations.
standards.status: Applicable from 1 April 2026; FOD Economy publication updated 30 October 2026
standards.notes: Regulatory installation requirements, not a reference-designation prefix code list. Check the applicable book and amendments for each installation.
